author: KEXP
description: Oakland's B. DeVeaux roots their neo-soul, R&B sound in transformative and vulnerable storytelling. Joining us Live on KEXP at Noise Pop, they perform "Safe Place (Dear, B)" & more.
title: B. DeVeaux performs "Safe Place (Dear, B)" & more Live on KEXP
